units.source_text: 到了年底，太君专心一志地为夕雾准备新年服装，其他一切都不顾。

en.t: At the end of the year, the grandmother devoted herself entirely to preparing New Year clothes for Yugiri, neglecting everything else.

units.source_text: 她替外孙做了许多套漂亮的衣服，但夕雾看也不要看。

en.t: She made many beautiful outfits for her grandson, but Yugiri would not even look at them.

units.source_text: 他说：“元旦我不一定入宫贺年，外婆何必如此忙着替我做衣服呢？”

en.t: He said, "I may not go to the palace to offer New Year greetings on New Year's Day, so why must you hurry so much to make clothes for me, Grandmother?"

units.source_text: 太君说：“你怎么可以不入宫贺年！

en.t: The grandmother said, "How could you possibly fail to go to the palace for New Year greetings!

units.source_text: 这倒像是老人病夫的话。”

en.t: That sounds like something an old sick man would say."

units.source_text: 夕雾自言自语地说：“年纪倒没有老，却真像个病夫了。”

en.t: Yugiri murmured to himself, "I am not old in years, but I really do seem like a sick man."

units.source_text: 说着流下泪来。

en.t: As he said this, tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 太君知道他是为云居雁之事伤心，觉得很可怜，也几乎哭起来。

en.t: The grandmother knew that he was grieving over Kumoi no Kari, and feeling sorry for him, she nearly began to cry herself.

units.source_text: 对他说道：“凡为男子的，即使身份低微，也应该气宇轩昂。

en.t: She said to him, "Any man, even one of low rank, ought to hold himself with dignity.

units.source_text: 你身份高贵，更不应该垂头丧气。

en.t: Since you are of noble birth, you should all the more avoid hanging your head in dejection.

units.source_text: 你心中有什么忧愁？

en.t: What sorrow is there in your heart?

units.source_text: 这样有伤身体啊。”

en.t: Going on like this will harm your health."

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“并无什么忧愁。

en.t: Yugiri said, "There is no particular sorrow.

units.source_text: 只因区区一个六位小官，被别人看不起。

en.t: It is only that, as a mere minor official of the sixth rank, I am looked down upon by others.

units.source_text: 虽然知道这六位是暂时的，总觉得没有面子进宫。

en.t: Although I know this sixth rank is only temporary, I still feel too ashamed to go to the palace.

units.source_text: 要是外公在世，别人开玩笑也不敢欺侮我哩。

en.t: If my grandfather were still alive, no one would dare mistreat me, even in jest.

units.source_text: 爸爸虽然是我的亲爹，但显然把我当作外人看待，连他的房间里也不许我随便出入。

en.t: My father is my own true father, yet he plainly treats me like an outsider and will not even let me come and go freely in his rooms.

units.source_text: 我只能在东院的西殿里接近他。

en.t: I can approach him only in the western hall of the East Wing.

units.source_text: 那里的继母固然很疼爱我，但倘我自己的母亲还在世，我更可无忧无虑呢。”

en.t: The stepmother there is certainly very kind to me, but if my own mother were still alive, I could be far more carefree."

units.source_text: 说着掉下眼泪来，便把头扭过去。

en.t: As he spoke, tears fell, and he turned his head away.

units.source_text: 太君看了更觉可怜，也纷纷落泪。

en.t: Seeing this, the grandmother pitied him even more and shed many tears herself.

units.source_text: 后来说道：“母亲早死的人，不论身份高低，都是很可怜的。

en.t: After a while she said, "People whose mothers die early are pitiable, whatever their rank may be.

units.source_text: 然而各人都有自己的幸运，不久成人立业之后，就无人敢看轻他了。

en.t: Yet everyone has his own good fortune, and once he soon comes of age and establishes himself, no one will dare look down on him.

units.source_text: 你决不可伤心。

en.t: You must not grieve.

units.source_text: 你外公能再多活几年才好。

en.t: If only your grandfather could have lived a few more years.

units.source_text: 你爸爸是和外公一样尽心竭力地照顾你的，我也依靠他。

en.t: Your father cares for you with the same wholehearted devotion as your grandfather did, and I depend on him as well.

units.source_text: 然而不称心的事真多呢。

en.t: Still, there are so many things that do not go as one wishes.

units.source_text: 外人都称赞你舅舅是个非常贤能的人，然而他对待我，比从前越来越不如了。

en.t: Outsiders all praise your uncle as an extraordinarily capable and virtuous man, yet his treatment of me has grown worse and worse compared with the past.

units.source_text: 我即使寿长，亦甚痛苦。

en.t: Even though I have lived long, it is still very painful.

units.source_text: 像你这样前程远大之人，也不免于忧患，虽然这忧患是极小的。

en.t: Even someone like you, with such a great future ahead, cannot escape sorrow, though this sorrow is very small.

units.source_text: 可见人世苦多乐少啊。”

en.t: This shows that in human life there is much suffering and little joy."

units.source_text: 说着流下泪来。

en.t: As she said this, tears began to fall.
